sql: SELECT t.name AS territory_name, SUM(h.subtotal) AS subtotal_sum FROM sales.salesorderheader AS h JOIN sales.salesterritory AS t ON h.territoryid = t.territoryid WHERE h.orderdate >= CAST('2013-01-01' AS DATE) AND h.orderdate < CAST('2014-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY t.territoryid, t.name ORDER BY subtotal_sum DESC NULLS LAST, t.name ASC LIMIT 200
